## Abstract

The Soils4Africa project aimed to collect soil samples from 20,000 locations across Africa’s agricultural lands. To support this effort, a continent-wide sampling scheme was developed to identify sampling locations using a probability-based sampling approach. This report describes the design and implementation of that sampling scheme. The soil data derived from the collected samples formed the foundation of the continental-scale soil information system (SIS) developed by the Soils4Africa project. The SIS is currently available at: https://africasis.isric.org/.
